_comment: Canonical anti-censorship HTTP fallback attempt sequence, the cross-language mirror of warren_contract::fallback::fallback_candidates. When the primary control-plane host is unreachable at connect time, a client retries the same request across hosts and SNI settings in this exact order: primary host with SNI, then each alternative host in order with SNI, then the primary host WITHOUT SNI. It stops at the first attempt that connects; when all fail it reports every host blocked. CORE-FIRST from the production warren-api-client: an alternative host is NEVER tried without SNI (the divergent four-step SDK variant is not canonical). Synthetic hosts only.
